findings.issue: The file's own docstring calls these lemmas "the inputs for packaging the standard matrices as a `TauCeti.IsSerreSystem`", and every input is present at the PR head, yet no `IsSerreSystem` instance is exposed. The public surface is seven scattered relation lemmas, three of which state the Cartan entry in a different form from `IsSerreSystem`'s fields, so each downstream consumer must reassemble and re-bridge them.

summary: All seven IsSerreSystem fields for the type-B generators now exist in-repo, but the PR stops at loose relation lemmas, so the roadmap product (a Serre system for the explicit type-B matrices) is still unstateable by any consumer without re-bridging the Cartan-entry convention. I withdraw the earlier Cartan-spelling finding: `CartanMatrix.B (n+1) j i` and `(CartanMatrix.B (n+1))ᵀ i j` differ by one `Matrix.transpose_apply`, the naming angle owns that choice, and the packaged theorem below fixes the convention for consumers either way.
